name: First steps
beschreibung: A small practice project: go through the whole flow once – give an instruction, start the AI, look at the result. The project folder is in the fabBoard data folder under “beispiele”.

items.titel: 1. There is already an instruction for the AI at the top
items.text: Under “To …” you will find an open message: the AI should create a file hello.txt. You write your own instructions in the same field.
The AI now works in the project folder. This usually takes a minute or two; the button pulses meanwhile. “Follow” shows what it is doing right now.

items.titel: 3. Which greeting should go into the file?
items.text: The AI reads your answers on its next run. Pick an answer and start the AI again – it will then change the file accordingly.

nachrichten.text: Create the file hello.txt with a short greeting in the project folder and say in one sentence in your answer what you did.
